item6.rule: the taxes on the business capital that serves the group's jobs: corporate tax (corporate_capital, corporate_labor), business property tax (remaining_production_property) and other taxes on production, re-keyed at every receipt scenario to the group's job-capital amount by cell shifts (national totals hold) and responding as meta.responses sets; the owners keep the same after-tax return, so P and F do not move, and the production module's capital-tax term stays 0 at every case specification (capital_tax_retention 1), so nothing counts twice
item6.amounts: on each model line L of the lane's line g, at each scenario and allocation: J = (union_G1 + union_G2 + union_G3plus + lineage_g3plus + lineage_whites) x T / N_g, T the cell's total (target plus other) and N_g the national of g's model lines; union_G = the lane's by_generation[G][g]; lineage_x = the added people's share of the case's wage key (corporate_labor at cbo_collective) for part x times the lane's factor (G3plus for the G3+ members, white_nh for the whites) for g times g's national_bn

lineage.rule: the added people's share of the case's wage key from their own cells on corporate_labor at cbo_collective, split into the G3+ members (later x G_L + (1 - C3) g3 x G_3) and the whites (C3 g3 x W_3) by the lineage item's part models, times the lane's G3plus and white_nh factors

production.rule: the production module's capital-tax term is 0.246 x (domestic capital gain - capital_tax_retention x opportunity income); at every case specification the state's production cell has capital_adjustment 1, capital_tax_retention 1 and no excluded owners, where the term is 0 (full_account_benefits_2026_09_20 upstream_replay scenarios.csv; main_case.cjs gates it)

mining_as_other_industries.label: mining's three taxes respond as other industries' do (the build before 2026-10-14)

normal_return_share.label: corporate at TP-5's normal-return share (0.37) at both readings

normal_return_share_0_25.label: the high reading's corporate response at Power and Frerick's 2003-2013 normal-return share (Treasury OTA Working Paper 111, abstract)

normal_return_share_by_industry.label: the high reading's corporate response at each industry's normal-return share (Power and Frerick Table 1, 2011-2013), as the union's personal effective share

plain_wage_share.label: the plain wage share in place of the industry key: every line's base at each group's share of all CPS wages on this lane's frame

foreign_source_removed.label: federal tax on foreign-source corporate income removed from the corporate base (IRS SOI TY2021)

business_land_at_0.label: business land at response 0: the land part of business property tax stays

business_land_at_1.label: business land at response 1: the whole business property tax leaves

floor.label: the floor: CBO's labour share of corporate tax only, at the case's wage key; the other lines at response 0

case_wage_key.label: the case's wage key (the status rules at the on-books lane's shares) in place of all CPS wages: each generation's targets times its share of the case's wage key over its plain share on this lane's frame

source.verdict: Taxes on the business capital that serves the group's jobs come to **$66.5bn a year at the band's low end
